slice.why_no_supports: In the 10-30 print's G-code (../print-20261030-retry/issue55_sleeves_A1mini_PLA_gui.gcode.3mf), per object: the main shells had only small bridges (tops of the horizontal M3 holes, a 3.5 x 5.3 mm ceiling at z 29.2, internal bridges) and at most a few mm of overhang wall per layer; all tree supports (layers 1-28) and the big bridges and overhang walls (layers 18, 29, 40-41) were under the fixing shells, where the nest was first seen (layers 21-48). After the fixing shells finished at layer 76, the strings that grew came off the two main shells, which the nozzle travelled between on every layer. 'Floating vertical shell' in that G-code, which the 10-30 run read as walls over nothing, is Bambu's role for solid infill laid on sparse infill, not extrusion over air. So the main shell was printed alone (nothing to travel to), unsupported; supports along its back face would have added islands to travel to. Damp filament remains possible and wasn't checked
